findings.message: The catalyst solution is transferred from the catalyst-preparation vessel to the second microwave vial. Representing it only as a reagent addition omits its source vessel.

findings.quote: the resulting solution was stirred at 100C for 1h in the microwave.
findings.message: The temperature, duration and stirring are captured, but microwave heating is not preserved outside step evidence. Because HeatChill has no allowed heating-method field, preserve this condition in unmapped_actions.
